posts.text:
My opponent calls Trump’s health care cuts “good for Minnesota.” And when Trump refused to extend the premium tax credits, she stood by and did nothing. 

As Governor, I’ll take action to bring down prescription drug costs and give Minnesotans relief from rising premiums. 

Minnesotans deserve a Governor who does what’s right for them – not what’s right for a Wisconsin billionaire donor and Donald Trump.

Retired nurse Tom Smart worked at Winona Health as a nurse for 20 years. 
He went from provider to patient in an instant when he had a heart attack. When every second counts, he was able to turn to care right in his community: Winona Health.

But Trump’s cuts are putting hospitals like Winona at risk. That puts lives at risk, too.
As your Governor, I will fight to keep your health care close to home.

We need a Governor who is going to put Minnesotans first. When Donald Trump refused to extend the health insurance premium tax credits and Minnesotans’ health care costs shot up, Lisa Demuth stood by and did nothing. That’s not leadership. 

If Donald Trump and his rubber stamp Republicans won’t act, states need to do it themselves. As Governor, I’ll extend these tax credits on the state level so Minnesotans can get some relief from skyrocketing costs.

posts.text:
I introduced one of the first bills in the Senate to help veterans exposed to toxic burn pits. That fight became part of the bipartisan PACT Act, and this week marks 4 years since this landmark legislation was signed into law — expanding VA health care to nearly 3.5 million veterans exposed to toxic substances. 

When we ask our young men and women to fight for our nation, we make a promise to care for them when they come home. The PACT Act is a promise kept.
